evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'do you have any important concerns or instructions for this move that you want us to take note of' — asked before some discovery but after the initial framing, then probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Edward raises two concerns: (1) two large furniture pieces need to go upstairs with circular stairs and railings — Joanna asks 'are all of the items that we need to bring on the second floor will be... brought up through those stairs?' and 'what are those items? do you think it's over £300... (2) Not everything in condo is coming — Joanna follows up 'that's true that's correct, cause our trucks can accommodate 1800 square foot homes if we need to go over that then we'll definitely... having a second truck will give you four guys but if everything will fit in just one truck then maybe we can just a third mover.'

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, square footage, floor layout, parking, special furniture considerations, box count) across the call and correctly identified this as a 2,000 sq ft condo requiring a virtual walkthrough before pricing could be finalized.
coaching_note: Use Section 2's explicit agenda-setting question ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?') *before* diving into probing — Joanna asked it mid-discovery rather than as a dedicated, framed pause, and did not reflect back what she heard to confirm completeness.
